column1: # Test shards for hosted CI (issue 452). One line per test class: <project> TAB <shard> TAB <class>.
# A project named here is split into its named shards plus an implicit shard "rest" that runs every
# other class of the project. Each line is read by scripts/verify-dotnet.sh and by
# scripts/check-dotnet-matrix.py. The format is described in docs/engineering/dotnet-verification.md.
# The nine Verifier classes are the xUnit collection "B10 abrupt verifier", which runs without
# parallelization, so they are split across two shards by whole class.
